items.title: Approve the Minutes of the September 9, 2025 Meeting Consent Agenda

Allocate $14,340,000 in Prop L Funds for Three Requests and Amend the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the Next Generation Sanchez Slow Street Project
Authorize an Additional Construction Allotment of $9,635,000 for the West Side Bridges Seismic Retrofit Project
Adopt a Resolution Authorizing the Executive Director to Request to the Metropolitan Transportation Commission for the Yerba Buena Island Multi-Use Pathway and Demonstrating Project
Approve Programming of $1,374,000 to the Yerba Buena Island Multi-Use Pathway Segment 4 ? Treasure Island Road Improvements Project
Approve the Conceptual Safety-Focused Autonomous Vehicle Permitting Framework Report
Investment Report and Debt Expenditure Report for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2025
